programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S11/E4'. Wanneer Gerco van Deventer in 2017 in Libië ontvoer word, begin 'n marteling vir hom en sy familie. Selfs met hulp van die regering en internasionale organisasies, is daar ná byna 7 jaar nog geen sprake van redding nie.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S11/E5'. Ruan van Heerden word deur die liefdevolle Barnie en Magda aangeneem, maar hy's 'n probleemkind en met dwelms deurmekaar. Op 9 Januarie 2020 val hy en 'n vriend vir Barnie en Magda met messe aan en los hulle vir die dood.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas

programme.title: Emzini: A Family Legacy
programme.desc: 'S1/E92'. With Shaka behind bars, Rorisang makes a bold choice to stand by him. But as Shaka dares to dream of a future with her, the truth he's hiding threatens to tear it all apart.

programme.title: The Four Of Us
programme.desc: 'S1/E37'. Bobbi sends a letter to the Nhlapho family. Mathapelo gets car finance but loses her deposit. Busani is fired and sobs in Nkazimulo's arms.

programme.title: eGagasini - Waves Of Change
programme.desc: 'S1/E37'. Lwandle swallows a bitter pill as her mother stands by her father. The Shozi family make efforts to mend fences with Ayalanga, while she struggles fitting into a world she's keeping secret.

programme.title: Durban Gen
programme.desc: 'S1/E31'. Mbali has both Sibusiso and Lindelani's rage eating away at her. Precious fails in her latest attempt to convince Calvin about the abortion and confronts Thabo for being a liar.

programme.title: Rhythm City
programme.desc: 'S1/E62 - 62'. The battle between the real power brokers of the music industry: the record companies, promoters, producers, DJs and the stars - but also the wannabe stars, the has-beens, families and lovers.

programme.title: Twist of Fate
programme.desc: 'S3/E28'. Aliya pressures Pragya into securing Abhi's signature on property papers, leaving Pragya guilty and emotional, while Disha grows suspicious after finding her in tears.

programme.title: India: A Love Story
programme.desc: 'S1/E87'. 'India: A Love Story' is a contemporary story set in Brazil and India, a thrilling tale exploring the clash between different cultures and traditions.

programme.title: Lente Na Die Storm
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. Bahar receives disheartening news. Gulcicek wants to support her daughter, but her hands are tied. Rengin wants more from Timur in the future.

programme.title: Bloedspoor
programme.desc: 'S2/E92'. Turgut Ali is informed that Ilgaz has been shot and killed, and all evidence points to Ceylin being the murderer. A nervous Parla dodges her family's questions about her whereabouts after the school fire.

programme.title: Bittersoet
programme.desc: 'S1/E81'. Emir wants to take Nihan on a second honeymoon, to solidify their marriage. A photographer catches Nihan and Kemal in a compromising situation, threatening to ruin her reputation.

programme.title: Skree Dit Uit!
programme.desc: 'S1/E43'. Tensions are rising as everyone is trying to figure out who's sending these messages. Leyla overhears a conversation that reveals a secret. Ekim confronts Kanat about the note.

programme.title: Entertainment Set
programme.desc: Entertainment highlights, news and reviews.

programme.title: Yosef
programme.desc: 'S2/E56'. The team discovers Duygu's last known location, whilst Ali is desperately searching for Cafer. Canan meets with Seher, but things don't go as Canan had expected.

programme.title: Maanligsprokie
programme.desc: 'S1/E86'. Sevde's death brings to light other misdeeds, driving another wedge between Kursat and Gulizar. And Rasit might still have a player in the game, even after death.

programme.title: Een Wit Leuen
programme.desc: 'S1/E70'. The relationship between Sevket and Berrin finally comes to light. Aylin arrives at Nejat's house with the police to claim Kayra. Nejat and Suna prepare for a fight.

programme.title: Lente Na Die Storm
programme.desc: 'S1/E3'. Bahar needs an organ donor for life threatening surgery, but is devastated when the donor pulls out, causing her world and perceptions of family to crumble.

programme.title: Bloedspoor
programme.desc: 'S2/E93'. Metin collapses on his way to view Ilgaz's body. Turgut Ali decides to send Ozcan away when he starts asking the right questions.

programme.title: Fenix
programme.desc: 'S1/E73'. As Ozan and Cemre grow closer, Ruya and Omer grow further apart. Celebi gets his revenge on Iskender, but he wants more.

programme.title: Twist of Fate
